; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; ; ; :Categories: ; ; CRISP pipeline ; ; ; :author: ; ; ; ; ; :returns: ; ; ; :Params: ; ; folder : ; ; ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; step : ; ; ; ; cam : ; ; ; ; lre : ; ; ; ; oname : ; ; ; ; ; ; :history: ; ; 2013-06-04 : Split from monolithic version of crispred.pro. ; ; ;- pro red::prefilter_data, folder , step = step, cam = cam, lre = lre, oname = oname ; if(~keyword_set(step)) then step = 1L ; inam = 'red::sumprefilter_data : ' ; ; Prefilter scan taken usually with T_cam? ; IF(~keyword_set(cam)) THEN BEGIN print, inam + 'keyword cam not supplied -> using transmitted camera: '+self.camt cam = self.camt ENDIF ELSE print, inam + 'using camera -> '+cam ; ; find files spawn, 'find ' + folder + '/' + cam + '/ | grep im.ex', files nt = n_elements(files) if(files[0] eq '') then begin print, inam+'no files found in '+folder+'/'+cam+', skipping camera!' return endif ; ; sort files based on image number files = red_sortfiles(files) ; ; load dark camtag = (strsplit(file_basename(files[0]), '.',/extract))[0] df = self.out_dir+'/darks/'+camtag+'.dark' if(file_test(df)) then dd = f0(df) else begin print, inam+'dark not found in '+ self.out_dir+'/darks/' return endelse ; ; get states pfstat = red_getstates_pref(files) red_flagtuning, pfstat ; ; get unique states ustate = pfstat.state[uniq(pfstat.state, sort(pfstat.state))] ns = n_elements(ustate) ; print, inam+' found '+red_stri(ns)+' prefilter states' ; ; Loop states outdir = self.out_dir+'/prefilter_scan/' file_mkdir, outdir prf = fltarr(ns, 1024, 1024) wav = dblarr(ns) shre = lonarr(ns) slre = lonarr(ns) ; for ss = 0L, ns - 1 do begin ; pos = where((pfstat.state eq ustate[ss]) AND (pfstat.star eq 0), count) if(count eq 0) then continue print, inam+'adding images for state-> '+ustate[ss] ; ; sum files and remove dark prf[ss,*,*] = red_sumfiles(files[pos], time = time, /check) - dd ; ; Get wavelength from header hdr = strsplit(fzhead(files[pos[0]]),/extract) hdr = hdr[n_elements(hdr)-1] pl = strpos(hdr, 'LRE=u') if pl ne -1 then begin ph = strpos(hdr, 'HRE=u') hex = strmid(hdr, pl+6, 12)+strmid(hdr, ph+6, 12) legs = lonarr(6) reads, hex, legs, form='(6Z4)' lre=legs[0] hre=legs[3] pfstat.lre[pos] = lre pfstat.hre[pos] = hre shre[ss] = hre slre[ss] = lre IF(keyword_set(lre)) THEN wav[ss] = lre ELSE wav[ss] = hre endif ; endfor ; wav*=step ; pos = sort(wav) wav = wav[pos] prf = (temporary(prf))[pos,*,*] hre = shre[pos] lre = slre[pos] ; outdir = self.out_dir + '/prefilter/' file_mkdir, outdir IF(~keyword_set(oname)) THEN oname = cam + '.' + pfstat.pref[0] + '.idlsave' print, inam + 'saving data to -> '+outdir + oname save, file = outdir + oname, hre, lre, step, wav, prf ; return end
